entities.summary: Benedykt Henryk Tyszkiewicz (b. 1852-12-11, Nemėžis) was a musician or composer of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Nemėžis and Poland. Known in the fields of poland, painters & sculptors, europe.
